summary.overall_findings: Advanced Micro Devices' policy documents detail AI model training metrics, data sources, and calculations for estimating the environmental impact of AI model training, demonstrating operational practices in transparency. Drawing from 15 publicly available sources, these disclosures show that all 7 evaluated pillars have documented public evidence, with technical papers describing pipelines for improving AI model fairness and policy documents mandating assessing AI-generated information for risks and accuracy. Further operational practices are evident in governance, where policy documents reference the establishment of the Responsible AI Council and its focus on AI governance. Explainability, privacy, and external accountability are addressed at the policy level, with technical papers detailing the release of model details and methodologies as part of a model release process, and policy documents referencing membership in the Responsible AI Institute.
